notes.title: Pixel Poops & DLC update: 9/26/2021
notes.notes:
Pixel Poops has been updated to version 1.02 as of 9/26/2021.

The following change was made in this version:


 A third secret code has been added that changes the appearance of your poop. Listen to the Orange Lounge Radio podcast and you may discover them! (The codes will be published at a later date in the manual/FAQ. Or, try to discover them yourself!)


Thank you for playing Pixel Poops!

notes.title: Pixel Poops & DLC update: 9/12/2021
notes.notes:
Pixel Poops has been updated to version 1.01 as of 9/12/2021.

The following changes were made in this version:

 Two secret codes have been added that change the appearance of your poop.  Listen to the Orange Lounge Radio podcast and you may discover them!  (The codes will be published at a later date.  Or, try to discover them yourself!)
 System stability has been improved. ;)


Pixel Poops Number Two has been updated to rev.B as of 9/12/2021.  (The original ROM is still also included, but you'll need to launch it manually.)

The following changes have been made in this version:

 10 new levels have been added, for a total of 50.
 You can now play as 2 additional female characters. (HOLD the A Button on the title screen when you press Start to play as the new characters.)
 Continuing will now restart you on the same level where you failed, instead of having to restart the whole world.


Thank you for playing Pixel Poops!

notes.title: 2021/2/17 update notes
notes.notes: Pixel Poops Number Two was updated to fix a bug in Player 2's physics.  (There were no changes to the other games.)
